description: This source file defines an interface for a service handling data table checks within the Fineract project. It declares methods for creating, deleting, and running validation checks related to data tables.

classes.name: EntityDatatableChecksWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing data table validation checks such as creating, deleting, and executing checks.

methods.name: createCheck
methods.description: Creates a new data table check based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteCheck
methods.description: Deletes an existing data table check identified by its ID.

methods.name: runTheCheck
methods.description: Executes a specific check for an entity, given its ID, name, status, foreign key column, and entity subtype.

methods.name: runTheCheckForProduct
methods.description: Performs a check for a product entity with specified parameters, including a product loan ID.

methods.name: saveDatatables
methods.description: Saves data table entries with given status, entity, entity ID, product ID, and JSON data.
